heading.en: Neither too much nor too little

hook.en: A wedding family that borrows too little runs out of money midway; one that borrows too much pays needless interest. Firms face the same problem.
hook.kn: ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಾಲ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಾಲ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಬಡ್ಡಿ. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಇದೇ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ.

body.en: Financial planning is preparing a financial blueprint of an organisation's future operations. Its two objectives are: to ensure availability of funds whenever required, and to see that the firm does not raise resources unnecessarily. It usually covers 3 to 5 years and is backed by short-term budgets.
body.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಯೋಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಗಳ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ನೀಲನಕ್ಷೆ. ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದಾಗ ಹಣ ಲಭ್ಯವಾಗಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ತಪ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ಇದರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು.

Its two objectives are: to ensure availability of funds whenever required, and to see that the firm does not raise resources unnecessarily. It usually covers 3 to 5 years and is backed by short-term budgets.
narration.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಯೋಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಗಳ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ನೀಲನಕ್ಷೆ. ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದಾಗ ಹಣ ಲಭ್ಯವಾಗಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ತಪ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ಇದರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು.

body.en: Financial planning forecasts what may happen under different situations, helps avoid business shocks and surprises, coordinates the various business functions, reduces waste and duplication, links the present with the future and links investment with financing decisions. It also makes evaluation of actual performance easier.
body.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಯೋಜನೆ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಅಂದಾಜಿಸಲು, ಆಘಾತ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು, ಸಮನ್ವಯ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು, ವ್ಯರ್ಥ ತಡೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಧನೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A firm forecasts sales of ₹2 crore next year and needs ₹50 lakh of extra stock in October before the festival season. It arranges a bank credit line in June. Which objective of financial planning does this serve?

steps.en: Funds are needed at a specific time (October) for a specific use (stock).
Arranging them in advance ensures the money is available exactly when required.
Taking only a credit line, not a big loan, avoids idle funds.

answer.en: It ensures availability of funds when required without raising them unnecessarily.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A firm forecasts sales of ₹2 crore next year and needs ₹50 lakh of extra stock in October before the festival season. It arranges a bank credit line in June. Which objective of financial planning does this serve?
